gates.name: Docs match the relationships the code graph has
gates.checks: It compares what a reference page says about who uses a project, or what implements its contract, with the code graph. It warns when the graph is older than the working tree. Exit 3 means there is no code graph, and it never exits 2.
gates.fix: Correct the page so that it names the relationships the graph shows, or rebuild the graph when it is old.
